turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Pretty well, actually.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm writing a book review for school. How should I structure it?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Start with a short summary without spoilers, then say what worked and what didn't, and end with who you'd recommend it to.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How long should the summary be?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Keep it brief, maybe a paragraph. The teacher mostly wants your opinion and your reasons.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My mum is coming to visit and she's never taken the train here. I want to send her the easiest route.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: There are two. One change, but a long walk between platforms, or two changes with short walks. Which would she find easier?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One second, Moshi. Flatmate.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Grace, is it still raining out there?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Just drizzling now. The sky looks lighter over the hills.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Do you think it'll clear up in time for the market?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Maybe. If not, we can just take umbrellas. It's only a ten minute walk.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: True. I really want those peaches before they sell out.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Then let's not wait too long. Grab your jacket.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, back to you, it's your move.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Hmm, give me a second.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: All sorted, Moshi. Pick up where you were.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. So, which way is your mum coming?
